PLAN "Postpartum 12-Week Comprehensive Plan (C-section, home mat only)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe progressive return to strength, cardio, core, HIIT-ready, and breastfeeding support"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Weeks 1-4 (Recovery, walking only)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Recovery walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Gentle walking":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 15m
        cooldown:
          walking 2m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Recovery walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Steady walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 25m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Light movement":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 15m
        cooldown:
          walking 2m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Steady walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 25m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Longer recovery walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Gentle walk + pelvic floor":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 6m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Longer recovery walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Maintain steady walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Pre-clearance maintenance":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Maintain steady walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Weeks 5-8 (Light mat-based reintroduction, avoid abdominal strain until cleared)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Breathing, pelvic floor + walk":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 12m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower body gentle + brisk walk":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 15m
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Mobility and light cardio":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_adduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          superman 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 12m
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Posterior chain + walk":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 15m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower body control + brisk walk":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walking 15m
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility and easy cardio":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          superman 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 12m
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Control + longer walk":
        warmup:
          marching 4m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower body strength (bodyweight progressions) + walk":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 4m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Stability and light conditioning":
        warmup:
          marching 4m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          superman 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walking 12m
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Consolidation + brisk walk":
        warmup:
          marching 4m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower body control + walk":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 4m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Mobility and gentle cardio":
        warmup:
          marching 4m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20m
          superman 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Weeks 9-12 (Intensified progressive strengthening + cardio + core reintegration + low-impact HIIT introduction)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-body strength + steady cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          walking 15m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper body strength + intervals (low-impact)":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 4m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          marching 10m
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core-safe conditioning + brisk walk intervals":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Higher intensity lower body + walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper body intensity + conditioning":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 4m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          marching 15m
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core integration + steady cardio":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength focus + longer walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          walking 25m
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper + posterior chain + conditioning":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 4m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          marching 20m
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core power, stability + walk":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Final week - strong full body + cardio peak":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          walking 30m
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper body strength peak + conditioning":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          marching 20m
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core integration and recovery walk (HIIT-ready low-impact work)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 seconds rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          walking 25m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Core Reintroduction Guidance (timing and progressions)" (12 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Initial pelvic floor and breathing":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Build core control":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x10 seconds rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Increase control pre-clearance":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Maintain and prepare for clearance":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Post-op check reminder":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 0m "If cleared — gentle anti-extension":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Progress core control":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Introduce low-load dynamic core":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Increase volume and complexity":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 seconds rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Loaded anti-rotation and endurance":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 4x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Build endurance and integration":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 seconds rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 4x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Transition to regular core training":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 seconds rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m

  PHASE "HIIT Guidance (timing and low-impact progression)" (12 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 0m "No HIIT — recovery focus":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 0m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 0m "No HIIT — pelvic floor and breathing":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 0m "No HIIT — gentle core":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x10 seconds rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 0m "No HIIT — maintain low-impact":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Post-op check reminder — still avoid high impact":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 0m "If cleared at 6 weeks — do not add HIIT yet":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Introduce low-impact intervals (precursor)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          marching 3x60 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 10m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Build aerobic base with brisk walking":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Low-impact interval introduction":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 5x1..2m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Progress low-impact intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 6x1..2m rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Short low-impact HIIT-style session (only if comfortable)":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 4x1..2m rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          marching 2x1..2m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Begin gentle low-impact HIIT (monitor symptoms)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 5x1..2m rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          marching 2x1..2m rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m

  PHASE "Nutrition - Breastfeeding support (12 weeks)" (12 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Calorie and hydration guidance":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Macronutrient targets (adequate energy, protein, healthy fats, fiber)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Snack and meal examples (frequent nutrient-dense meals)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Hydration and timing (increase fluids, feed/express-friendly timing)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Iron and calcium-rich options (include lean protein, dairy/alternatives)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Protein focus (aim for protein each meal/snack)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Healthy fats and omega-3s (include oily fish, seeds)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Fiber and digestion (whole grains, fruit, veg)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Meal prep tips (batch snacks and meals, portable options)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Snacking for energy (balanced carbs+protein)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Supplements and physician consult (iron, vit D as advised)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 0m "Transition and goals (maintain milk supply while resuming activity)":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
          walking 0m
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
